description: Currency converter, exchange rates (USD, EUR, GBP and 30 more). Convert an amount between about 30 major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF, CNY, INR...) using the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, for the latest working day or a date in the last 90 days. Reference rates, not trading prices. Source: ECB. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: currency_convert
